description: Books the confirmed live call on the held slot — the ONLY slot/booking authority. Default: time = {{selected_time}} VERBATIM (never a UTC iso), timezone = {{prospect_timezone}}, slot_reservation_uids = {{slot_reservation_uids}} verbatim, booking_intent = {{booking_intent}} verbatim, preferred_time = ''. Follow the response: status 'booked' → read booking_uid; 'book_failed' → follow its message, NEVER claim success. RESCHEDULE (caller wants a different time AFTER one was confirmed): call extract_booking_intent first, then this tool with booking_intent as stored and preferred_time = the caller's new time (time stays {{selected_time}}); on 'reschedule_options' offer exactly the returned times; when they pick one, call again with BOTH time AND preferred_time = the chosen option. CANCEL: extract_booking_intent first, then this tool; on 'released' confirm politely, never book.
name: create_livecall_booking

account_id.description: Which calendar account to use. Fixed per agent — do not change.

time.description: The confirmed slot's local time, copied verbatim from {{selected_time}} — never recompute, never a UTC iso.

name.description: attendee name: "{{first_name}} {{last_name}}" (or "{{company_name}}" if no name was provided).

slot_reservation_uids.description: Pass {{slot_reservation_uids}} verbatim — the held slot uids. Never invent, shorten or modify them.

booking_intent.description: Pass {{booking_intent}} verbatim ('' when the caller never changed their mind).

preferred_time.description: '' by default. Only on a reschedule: the caller's newly requested time (first ask), or the chosen option's time on the confirm turn (must equal time).

description: Call ONCE, only when the caller, AFTER a time was confirmed, either asks for a different time or backs out entirely. Never call it otherwise; never call it before a time was confirmed.

variables.name: booking_intent
variables.description: reschedule = caller wants a different time than the confirmed one; cancel = caller no longer wants the call.

name: extract_booking_intent

description: Records the booking confirmation id. Call right after create_livecall_booking succeeds, passing booking_uid exactly as its result returned it (a 22-character code). The server verifies it against the calendar and records it itself - if it answers invalid_uid or uid_not_found, pass the uid again exactly as shown, up to three times; then treat it as calendar trouble. Never invent, shorten, or retype the uid.
name: record_booking_uid

booking_uid.description: The booking_uid from create_livecall_booking's result, copied verbatim.

description: Records the slot outcome. Set booking_verified=true ONLY when validate_booking returned valid:true. Set booking_failed=true ONLY after two consecutive calendar failures. Never set both.

variables.name: booking_verified
variables.description: true ONLY when validate_booking returned valid:true.
true ONLY after a second create_livecall_booking failure.
variables.name: booking_failed

name: record_booking_outcome
